additional_info.subject: Customer notes
additional_info.body:
Elektronische Sicherung im Dispenser für die ECO G Controller lösen aus und lassen sich nicht wieder zuschalten. Dadurch fährt das Ladegerät nicht hoch und alle vier Ladepunkte sind nicht nutzbar
Electronic fuse in the dispenser for the ECO G controller
trips and cannot be switched back on. As a result,
the charger does not start up and all four charging points cannot be used

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388002-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002073] All 4 Outlets unavailable CRM:00579001285
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
As per the customer -
Electronic fuse in the dispenser for the ECO G controller trips and cannot be switched back on.
Hence we need to check the following connections in dispenser:
Check 24v and 0v supply on both Ecog (KF9as211 and KF212) and  state monitor device (KF214).
Check the fuse
FC213 whether it is tripped
(as 24v supply to Ecogs is routed through this fuse). If found faulty, kindly replace it.
Feedback from fuses FC212, FC213, FC214 is provided to PLC. To check if 24v DC fuses are ok, check for the DI.a.5 pin on KF201.
To check if 24v DC power supply ok, check for DI.a.4 pin on KF201.
Input 24V DC supply to fuses FC212, FC213, FC214 is sourced from TB210. Hence check connections to TB210 as well.
Kindly perform the above steps and let us know the observations.
We will wait for your feedback to proceed further.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
